data.name: Bhishma
data.gender_notes: Bhishma is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Terrible; one who has taken a vow
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root bhī, 'to fear' — bhīṣma, 'terrible, awesome'. Its root is Sanskrit bhi (भी). Bhishma, the grandsire in the Mahabharata. Bhishma is a Sanskrit name meaning “Terrible; one who has taken a vow”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bhishma expresses “Terrible; one who has taken a vow”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root bhī, 'to fear' — bhīṣma, 'terrible, awesome'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhishma total 33, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
